description:
Retrieve a WindowsForum document by ID for analysis and citation.

Posts are returned in full. Threads include their first 50 visible posts.
Check metadata.truncated and metadata.pagination; continue long threads
with get_thread_posts(thread_id, offset=next_offset).

id.description:
Document ID — accepts "thread-XXX", "post-XXX", or a plain number
(plain numbers are looked up as thread first, then post)

name: fetch
title: Fetch document
